instruction: Open the spreadsheet file and locate cell B2. Copy the first name in that cell and use Chrome to search for it on Google.

metadata.explanation: Task requires copying cell B2 value 'Dulce' from Excel file and searching it in Chrome. Evaluator verifies that the active tab URL matches a Google search for 'dulce' (case-insensitive). Verified by reading complete Excel file: B2 contains 'Dulce' at row 1, column 1 (0-indexed).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the final outcome: active tab contains Google search URL for 'Dulce'

Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_info (chrome.py:803-890) extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree, navigates to it with Playwright, and returns dict with 'url', 'title', 'content' fields
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_search_query (chrome.py:247-256) extracts URL from result['url'] (line 253) and performs regex pattern matching with expected['pattern']
Expected pattern is semantically correct: '(?i)https?://(?:www\.)?google\.com/search\?q=dulce(?:&|$|#).*' matches Google search for 'dulce' (case-insensitive) with flexible query parameters
Expected value matches instruction requirement: pattern expects 'dulce' which matches cell B2 content 'Dulce' (verified in metadata explanation)
Data flow is correct: getter returns {url: string, title: string, content: string} -> metric accesses result['url'] -> regex.search(pattern, url) -> returns 1.0 if match else 0.0

No postconfig needed: evaluator runs after task completion when Chrome already displays search results in active tab; getter can navigate to the URL to extract info; rule validator warning is false positive
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies END STATE (Google search URL) which implicitly confirms all intermediate steps (open file, locate B2, copy value, search) were completed successfully
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 if active_tab_info is None or pattern doesn't match; getter handles navigation failures gracefully
